scope: Vegetable-stock adaptation. Forty grams of miso in 550 g stock is close to the reference 18 g per 240 ml. Bok choy stems cook first; tender greens and soft tofu cook briefly before miso is dissolved off the heat. Wakame was omitted because its iodine content is variable. AFCD F005702 combines four miso products. No physical trial was performed.
